mechanism: Systemic absorption of timolol can be enhanced by corticosteroid-induced changes in ocular blood flow and corneal permeability, potentially increasing beta-blocker systemic effects; corticosteroids may also mask signs of timolol toxicity.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate regularly; counsel patients on proper ocular instillation technique to minimize systemic absorption; consider alternative glaucoma agents if systemic beta-blockade is contraindicated.
